companyOperatedStores.label: Company-operated coffeehouses
companyOperatedStores.definition: Company-operated coffeehouses open as of Sep 27, 2026, 10-K Item 1 "Company-operated coffeehouse data" table (total 13,397). China's 7,991 transferred to licensed during fiscal 2026 when its retail operations moved to a licensed joint venture.

licensedStores.label: Licensed coffeehouses
licensedStores.definition: Licensed coffeehouses open as of Sep 27, 2026, 10-K Item 1 "Licensed coffeehouse data" table (total 28,210). Licensed coffeehouses are run by licensees; Starbucks receives a margin on branded products and supplies and a royalty on retail sales.

notes: Everything is from the FY2026 Form 10-K (fiscal year ended Sep 27, 2026), which now calls stores 'coffeehouses'. The 10-K gives coffeehouse counts by market, not by U.S. state, so usStates is null; none was taken from store-locator data. Company-operated and licensed coffeehouses are kept as separate metrics (the U.S., Canada and the U.K. appear in both tables; they are not added). In the third quarter of fiscal 2026 Starbucks moved its China retail operations to a licensed joint venture: 7,991 coffeehouses transferred from company-operated to licensed, so China now appears only in the licensed table (8,340) and its company-operated count is nil; China long-lived assets fell to $166.7 million. 'All Other' (64 company-operated, 4,350 licensed) and Siren Retail rows are residuals and are not shown. Latin America is the 10-K's licensed grouping with no country list. Employees are approximate: 221,000 in the U.S. and 85,000 outside it (no country split). Long-lived assets are given for the U.S., China, Japan and 'Other countries' (the residual, which includes the China joint-venture investment, is not shown). Sites are the full Item 2 table of material properties: the Shanghai office is no longer listed and was removed; Romeoville, IL and Nashville, TN are new.
